title: The Way You Look Tonight (F major)

details.title: The Way You Look Tonight
details.lead: Jerome Kern, 1936, words by Dorothy Fields. The chorus as it is written, both endings in their place, in F major: concert D4 to F5. Whole notes C and F open each A, then the line climbs by step to the high F; the middle part moves to A♭ and D♭, on repeated C and E♭. Where the band fills, the trumpet rests a bar or two. About 120 a minute.
